rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality day-5 blastocyst with plausible comments on blastocoel, ICM, TE, and possible stage/image mismatch; appropriately cautious about limits of a single static image, though some details are somewhat inferential.
Strong integration of maternal age, ovarian reserve, male factor, partner age, endometrium, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and structured, with conclusions generally supported by morphology and clinical context; minor inconsistency around Gardner stage terminology but overall coherent.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, attention to luteal support, cautious discussion of PGT-A, and further workup only if failures recur.
Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, and male-factor refinement; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
